title: Fast Track Judicial Access and Case Timeline Guarantee Bill
source_or_instruction: Public interest reform proposal establishing a statutory 12-month trial completion cap for criminal cases, 18-month cap for civil cases, automatic judicial vacancy filling, 24x7 e-court telemetry, and delay compensation.
notes: Matter 022: Fast Track Judicial Access and Case Timeline Guarantee Bill, 2026.
